name: desk-ocr
description: Privacy-first desktop screenshot OCR with searchable text overlays.
author: Desk OCR contributors

scripts.dist:mac: npm run check && npm run dist:mac:artifacts
scripts.dist:mac:artifacts: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:ocr && npm run build:licenses && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run check && npm run dist:win:artifacts
scripts.dist:win:artifacts: npm run generate:icons && npm run build:ocr && npm run build:licenses && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.lint:python: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff check services scripts
scripts.format:python: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff format services scripts
scripts.format:python:check: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m ruff format --check services scripts
scripts.check:frontend: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run check:electron-build
scripts.check: npm run check:frontend && npm run test:ocr && npm run lint:python && npm run format:python:check
